name: Language Tooling & LSP
purpose: Integrate, configure, and verify LSP and DAP language tooling: JSON-RPC lifecycle, capability negotiation, semantic queries, diagnostics, formatting, code actions, and debug sessions with measured latency budgets.
inputs: Target languages with pinned language-server versions and transport (stdio or TCP)
Client capability set: snippet support, pull vs push diagnostics, file watching
Latency budgets: startup under 2 s, hover p95 under 150 ms, completion p95 under 300 ms
Workspace root with served globs and excluded paths for generated and vendored code
outputs: Initialized LSP session with negotiated capabilities and synchronized workspace
Verified semantic query path for hover, definition, references, symbols, and formatting
Proven DAP launch and breakpoint flow with clean teardown plus latency report
stop_conditions: All latency budgets met with zero protocol errors on the replay script
Formatting proven idempotent and rename proven cross-file on the sample workspace
